tool_schemas.name: search-videos
tool_schemas.description: Searches YouTube for videos matching `query`, optionally localized/filtered by region, language, channel, category, publish window, ordering, and SafeSearch, and returns up to `limit` results plus the next `pageToken` when more results are available. Listing is paged via YouTube `pageToken` (omit for first page; pass the returned token to continue) and may read from or populate our cache depending on `cacheMode`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/ranges or malformed timestamps, NOT_FOUND when a referenced channel/category does not exist (or is not accessible), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller or upstream access is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded (CACHE_ONLY additionally raises NOT_FOUND when the requested page is not present in cache).

query.description: Search query text to find YouTube videos.

regionCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to localize search results (e.g., US, KR).

language.description: BCP-47 language code to bias results (e.g., en, en-US, ko).

channelId.description: YouTube channel ID to restrict results to a single channel.

categoryId.description: YouTube video category ID to restrict results.

publishedAfter.description: Only return videos published after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

publishedBefore.description: Only return videos published before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

pageToken.description: YouTube page token to continue a previous search.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.name: get-video-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comment threads for `videoId` ordered by `relevance` or `time`, returning up to `limit` threads and a next `pageToken` when more are available. Results are paged with YouTube `pageToken` and may be served from or written to cache according to `cacheMode`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `limit`/`order`, NOT_FOUND when the video does not exist, comments are disabled, or the requested page is missing in CACHE_ONLY mode, FORBIDDEN when the video/comments are not accessible to the caller, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

videoId.description: YouTube video ID to retrieve comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comment threads to return.

pageToken.description: YouTube page token to continue a previous comments listing.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.name: get-video-transcript
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the timestamped transcript/captions for `videoId` in the requested `language` when available, returning caption entries with text and time offsets (and using the video's default when `language` is omitted). Depending on `cacheMode`, we return a cached transcript, fetch and store it for reuse, or require it to already exist in cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid language codes, NOT_FOUND when the video or transcript in the requested language is unavailable (or not present in CACHE_ONLY), FORBIDDEN when captions cannot be accessed, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

videoId.description: YouTube video ID to fetch transcript/captions for.

language.description: Language code for the transcript (e.g., en, ko, ja); if omitted, the video's default is used.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.name: get-video-stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns current metadata and statistics for `videoId` (e.g., view/like/comment counts and publish information) and records the tool call for auditability. Depending on `cacheMode`, stats may be returned from cache, refreshed and stored, or required to already exist in cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid `videoId`, NOT_FOUND when the video does not exist (or is not present in CACHE_ONLY), FORBIDDEN when the video is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

videoId.description: YouTube video ID to retrieve statistics for.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_video_stats(videoId, cacheMode=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, hashlib, re, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0304000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0304000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if not isinstance(videoId, str) or not videoId.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "videoId must be a non-empty string", field="videoId")
    if cacheMode is None:
        cacheMode = "read_through"
    if not isinstance(cacheMode, str) or cacheMode not in ("bypass", "read_through", "cache_only"):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cacheMode must be one of: bypass,read_through,cache_only", field="cacheMode")

    canonical = {"videoId": videoId, "cacheMode": cacheMode}
    fp_src = "get-video-stats|" + json.dumps(canonical, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
    request_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(fp_src.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
    cached_req = None
    if cacheMode in ("read_through", "cache_only"):
        for r in api_requests:
            if r.get("tool_name") == "get-video-stats" and r.get("status") == "succeeded" and r.get("finished_at") is not None and r.get("request_fingerprint") == request_fingerprint:
                cached_req = r
                break

    req_id = "req_" + hashlib.sha256((request_fingerprint + "|" + now + "|" + str(random.random())).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]
    req_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "tool_name": "get-video-stats",
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": canonical,
        "request_fingerprint": request_fingerprint,
        "cache_mode": cacheMode,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "response_summary": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "youtube_quota_cost": 0,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    api_requests.append(req_row)
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    def _update_req(status, response_summary=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, youtube_quota_cost=None, cache_hit=None):
        req_row["status"] = status
        req_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        if req_row["started_at"] is None and status in ("running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
            req_row["started_at"] = req_row["updated_at"]
        if status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
            req_row["finished_at"] = req_row["updated_at"]
        if response_summary is not None:
            req_row["response_summary"] = response_summary
        if error_code is not None:
            req_row["error_code"] = error_code
        if error_message is not None:
            req_row["error_message"] = error_message
        if youtube_quota_cost is not None:
            req_row["youtube_quota_cost"] = int(youtube_quota_cost)
        if cache_hit is not None:
            req_row["cache_hit"] = bool(cache_hit)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    videos = _load("videos.json")
    channels = _load("channels.json")

    video_row = next((v for v in videos if v.get("youtube_video_id") == videoId), None)

    # cache_only requires video present with stats
    if cacheMode == "cache_only":
        if not video_row:
            _update_req("failed", response_summary={"reason": "cache_miss"}, error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="Video not present in cache", youtube_quota_cost=0, cache_hit=False)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Video not present in cache")
        if video_row.get("stats_fetched_at") is None or video_row.get("view_count") is None:
            _update_req("failed", response_summary={"reason": "cache_miss_stats"}, error_code="NOT_FOUND", error_message="Video stats not present in cache", youtube_quota_cost=0, cache_hit=True)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Video stats not present in cache")
        ch = next((c for c in channels if c.get("id") == video_row.get("channel_id")), None)
        _update_req("succeeded", response_summary={"videoId": videoId}, youtube_quota_cost=0, cache_hit=True)
        return {
            "requestId": req_id,
            "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": True},
            "video": {
                "videoId": video_row.get("youtube_video_id"),
                "title": video_row.get("title"),
                "publishedAt": video_row.get("published_at"),
                "durationSeconds": video_row.get("duration_seconds"),
                "defaultLanguage": video_row.get("default_language"),
                "thumbnailUrl": video_row.get("thumbnail_url"),
                "channel": {"channelId": ch.get("youtube_channel_id") if ch else None, "title": ch.get("title") if ch else None},
            },
            "stats": {
                "viewCount": video_row.get("view_count"),
                "likeCount": video_row.get("like_count"),
                "commentCount": video_row.get("comment_count"),
                "statsFetchedAt": video_row.get("stats_fetched_at"),
            },
        }

    _update_req("running")

    # If missing, create video after resolving its channel (business rule)
    def _gen_id(prefix):
        return prefix + "_" + hashlib.sha256((prefix + "|" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "|" + str(random.random())).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]

    def _ensure_channel_for_video():
        # if existing video has channel_id and channel exists, ok
        if video_row and video_row.get("channel_id") and any(c.get("id") == video_row.get("channel_id") for c in channels):
            return next(c for c in channels if c.get("id") == video_row.get("channel_id"))
        # otherwise create a placeholder channel
        ycid = "UC" + hashlib.sha256(videoId.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22]
        ch = next((c for c in channels if c.get("youtube_channel_id") == ycid), None)
        now2 = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        if ch:
            return ch
        ch = {
            "id": _gen_id("ch"),
            "youtube_channel_id": ycid,
            "title": "Unknown Channel",
            "handle": None,
            "country": None,
            "description": None,
            "thumbnail_url": None,
            "subscriber_count": None,
            "view_count": None,
            "video_count": None,
            "stats_fetched_at": None,
            "created_at": now2,
            "updated_at": now2,
        }
        channels.append(ch)
        _save("channels.json", channels)
        return ch

    if not video_row:
        ch = _ensure_channel_for_video()
        now2 = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        video_row = {
            "id": _gen_id("vid"),
            "youtube_video_id": videoId,
            "channel_id": ch["id"],
            "title": "Unknown Video",
            "description": None,
            "published_at": None,
            "duration_seconds": None,
            "default_language": None,
            "region_code": None,
            "category_id": None,
            "thumbnail_url": None,
            "view_count": None,
            "like_count": None,
            "comment_count": None,
            "stats_fetched_at": None,
            "trending_rank": None,
            "trending_fetched_at": None,
            "created_at": now2,
            "updated_at": now2,
        }
        videos.append(video_row)

    # Determine whether cached is acceptable for read_through
    def _is_recent(fetched_at, max_age_hours=6):
        if not fetched_at:
            return False
        try:
            fa = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(fetched_at[:-1] if fetched_at.endswith("Z") else fetched_at)
            return (datetime.datetime.utcnow() - fa) <= datetime.timedelta(hours=max_age_hours)
        except Exception:
            return False

    if cacheMode == "read_through" and video_row.get("stats_fetched_at") and _is_recent(video_row.get("stats_fetched_at")):
        ch = next((c for c in channels if c.get("id") == video_row.get("channel_id")), None)
        _update_req("succeeded", response_summary={"videoId": videoId}, youtube_quota_cost=0, cache_hit=True)
        return {
            "requestId": req_id,
            "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": True},
            "video": {
                "videoId": video_row.get("youtube_video_id"),
                "title": video_row.get("title"),
                "publishedAt": video_row.get("published_at"),
                "durationSeconds": video_row.get("duration_seconds"),
                "defaultLanguage": video_row.get("default_language"),
                "thumbnailUrl": video_row.get("thumbnail_url"),
                "channel": {"channelId": ch.get("youtube_channel_id") if ch else None, "title": ch.get("title") if ch else None},
            },
            "stats": {
                "viewCount": video_row.get("view_count"),
                "likeCount": video_row.get("like_count"),
                "commentCount": video_row.get("comment_count"),
                "statsFetchedAt": video_row.get("stats_fetched_at"),
            },
        }

    # Refresh stats (offline deterministic update)
    seed = int(hashlib.sha256(videoId.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
    base = seed % 10_000_000
    # increment with day to simulate change
    day = int(datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%j"))
    view = base + (day % 10000) * 37
    like = max(0, int(view * 0.05))
    comment = max(0, int(view * 0.01))

    # enforce non-negative constraints
    view = int(max(0, view))
    like = int(max(0, like))
    comment = int(max(0, comment))

    now2 = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    video_row["view_count"] = view
    video_row["like_count"] = like
    video_row["comment_count"] = comment
    video_row["stats_fetched_at"] = now2
    video_row["updated_at"] = now2

    _save("videos.json", videos)

    ch = next((c for c in channels if c.get("id") == video_row.get("channel_id")), None)

    quota_cost = 0 if (cached_req is not None and cacheMode != "bypass") else 1  # videos.list typically costs 1

    _update_req("succeeded", response_summary={"videoId": videoId, "refreshed": True}, youtube_quota_cost=quota_cost, cache_hit=False)
    return {
        "requestId": req_id,
        "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": False},
        "video": {
            "videoId": video_row.get("youtube_video_id"),
            "title": video_row.get("title"),
            "publishedAt": video_row.get("published_at"),
            "durationSeconds": video_row.get("duration_seconds"),
            "defaultLanguage": video_row.get("default_language"),
            "thumbnailUrl": video_row.get("thumbnail_url"),
            "channel": {"channelId": ch.get("youtube_channel_id") if ch else None, "title": ch.get("title") if ch else None},
        },
        "stats": {
            "viewCount": video_row.get("view_count"),
            "likeCount": video_row.get("like_count"),
            "commentCount": video_row.get("comment_count"),
            "statsFetchedAt": video_row.get("stats_fetched_at"),
        },
    }

tool_schemas.name: get-channel-stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns current channel metadata and statistics for `channelId` (e.g., subscriber count, total views, and video count) and records the tool call for auditability. Depending on `cacheMode`, data may be served from cache, refreshed and stored, or required to already exist in cache. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid `channelId`, NOT_FOUND when the channel does not exist (or is not present in CACHE_ONLY), FORBIDDEN when the channel is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

channelId.description: YouTube channel ID to retrieve statistics for.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.name: compare-videos
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns comparable statistics for each `videoId` in `videoIds` so you can evaluate multiple videos side-by-side in a single call, using cache according to `cacheMode`. The response includes one entry per requested video ID; IDs that cannot be retrieved are reported as errors rather than silently omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `videoIds` violates size constraints or contains invalid IDs, NOT_FOUND when one or more videos do not exist (or are missing in CACHE_ONLY), FORBIDDEN when one or more videos are not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

videoIds.description: List of YouTube video IDs to compare.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.name: get-trending-videos
tool_schemas.description: Lists trending videos for `regionCode`, optionally filtered by `categoryId`, returning up to `limit` items and a next `pageToken` when additional pages exist. Listing is paged via YouTube `pageToken` and is served from or stored into cache based on `cacheMode`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid region/category formats or `limit`, NOT_FOUND when the region/category has no available feed or the requested page is missing in CACHE_ONLY, FORBIDDEN when trending data is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

regionCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to fetch trending videos for (e.g., US, JP).

categoryId.description: YouTube video category ID to filter trending results.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return.

pageToken.description: YouTube page token to continue a previous trending listing.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_trending_videos(regionCode, categoryId=None, limit=None, pageToken=None, cacheMode=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, random, base64

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0304000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0304000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _stable_fingerprint(tool_name, params):
        def _canon(v):
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                return {k: _canon(v[k]) for k in sorted(v.keys())}
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [_canon(x) for x in v]
            return v
        blob = json.dumps({"tool_name": tool_name, "params": _canon(params)}, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{random.randint(1000,9999)}"

    def _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cache_mode, quota_cost):
        ts = _now()
        return {
            "id": _new_id("req"),
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "status": "queued",
            "request_params": params,
            "request_fingerprint": _stable_fingerprint(tool_name, params),
            "cache_mode": cache_mode,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "response_summary": None,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "youtube_quota_cost": int(quota_cost),
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }

    def _set_status(req_row, status, error_code=None, error_message=None, response_summary=None):
        ts = _now()
        allowed = {
            "queued": ["running", "cancelled"],
            "running": ["succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"],
            "succeeded": [],
            "failed": [],
            "cancelled": [],
        }
        cur = req_row.get("status")
        if status != cur:
            if cur not in allowed or status not in allowed[cur]:
                return False
        req_row["status"] = status
        req_row["updated_at"] = ts
        if status == "running" and not req_row.get("started_at"):
            req_row["started_at"] = ts
        if status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
            if not req_row.get("started_at"):
                req_row["started_at"] = ts
            req_row["finished_at"] = ts
        req_row["error_code"] = error_code
        req_row["error_message"] = error_message
        req_row["response_summary"] = response_summary
        return True

    start = time.time()
    tool_name = "get-trending-videos"
    params = {"regionCode": regionCode}
    if categoryId is not None:
        params["categoryId"] = categoryId
    if limit is not None:
        params["limit"] = limit
    if pageToken is not None:
        params["pageToken"] = pageToken
    if cacheMode is not None:
        params["cacheMode"] = cacheMode

    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
    videos = _load("videos.json")
    channels = _load("channels.json")
    categories = _load("video_categories.json")

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(regionCode, str) or len(regionCode) != 2 or not regionCode.isalpha() or regionCode.upper() != regionCode:
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode or "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "regionCode must be a 2-letter uppercase ISO country code (e.g., US).", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "regionCode must be a 2-letter uppercase ISO country code (e.g., US).")
    if categoryId is not None and (not isinstance(categoryId, str) or not categoryId.strip()):
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode or "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "categoryId must be a non-empty string when provided.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "categoryId must be a non-empty string when provided.")
    if limit is None:
        limit = 25
    if not isinstance(limit, int) or limit < 1 or limit > 50:
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode or "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "limit must be an integer between 1 and 50.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "limit must be an integer between 1 and 50.")
    if pageToken is not None and (not isinstance(pageToken, str) or not pageToken.strip()):
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode or "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "pageToken must be a non-empty string when provided.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pageToken must be a non-empty string when provided.")
    if cacheMode is None:
        cacheMode = "read_through"
    if cacheMode not in ("bypass", "read_through", "cache_only"):
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "cacheMode must be one of: bypass, read_through, cache_only.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cacheMode must be one of: bypass, read_through, cache_only.")

    # Request row
    req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode, 0)
    api_requests.append(req)
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
    if not _set_status(req, "running"):
        _set_status(req, "failed", "INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal api_requests status transition.")
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal api_requests status transition.")

    # Resolve category FK if provided and known
    category_row = None
    if categoryId is not None:
        for c in categories:
            if c.get("region_code") == regionCode and c.get("youtube_category_id") == categoryId:
                category_row = c
                break
        # If explicitly filtering by a category that is unknown in our cache, treat as not found (no available feed)
        if not category_row and cacheMode == "cache_only":
            _set_status(req, "failed", "NOT_FOUND", "Category not found in cache for region (cache_only).", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Category not found in cache for region (cache_only).")

    # Decode pageToken as offset
    offset = 0
    if pageToken:
        try:
            raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(pageToken.encode("utf-8") + b"===")
            offset = int(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            if offset < 0:
                offset = 0
        except Exception:
            _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid pageToken.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid pageToken.")

    # Cache-only: list from stored trending snapshot
    def _matches(v):
        if v.get("region_code") != regionCode:
            return False
        if not v.get("trending_rank") or not v.get("trending_fetched_at"):
            return False
        if category_row:
            return v.get("category_id") == category_row.get("id")
        if categoryId is not None and not category_row:
            return False
        return True

    if cacheMode == "cache_only":
        pool = [v for v in videos if _matches(v)]
        pool.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("trending_rank") if isinstance(r.get("trending_rank"), int) else 10**9)
        if not pool:
            _set_status(req, "failed", "NOT_FOUND", "No trending feed available in cache for this region/category.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No trending feed available in cache for this region/category.")
        page = pool[offset:offset + limit]
        next_offset = offset + len(page)
        next_token = None
        if next_offset < len(pool):
            next_token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(str(next_offset).encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8").rstrip("=")
        req["cache_hit"] = True
        _set_status(req, "succeeded", response_summary={"returned": len(page), "total_cached": len(pool), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return {
            "regionCode": regionCode,
            "categoryId": categoryId,
            "items": page,
            "pageToken": next_token,
            "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": True},
            "request": {"id": req["id"], "youtube_quota_cost": req["youtube_quota_cost"], "status": req["status"]},
        }

    # bypass/read_through: "fetch" trending list deterministically and upsert
    quota_cost = 1
    req["youtube_quota_cost"] = quota_cost

    seed_base = f"trending:{regionCode}:{categoryId or ''}"
    seed = int(hashlib.sha256(seed_base.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # generate a synthetic feed of 200 ids
    feed_size = 200
    feed_ids = []
    for i in range(feed_size):
        vid = hashlib.sha1(f"{seed_base}:{i}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:11]
        feed_ids.append(vid)

    if offset >= len(feed_ids):
        # no available page
        _set_status(req, "failed", "NOT_FOUND", "No trending feed available for this pageToken.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No trending feed available for this pageToken.")

    slice_ids = feed_ids[offset:offset + limit]
    now = _now()

    def _ensure_channel(youtube_video_id):
        ch_yid = "UC" + hashlib.sha1(("ch:"+youtube_video_id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:22]
        ch = next((r for r in channels if r.get("youtube_channel_id") == ch_yid), None)
        if not ch:
            ch = {
                "id": _new_id("ch"),
                "youtube_channel_id": ch_yid,
                "title": ch_yid,
                "handle": None,
                "country": regionCode,
                "description": None,
                "thumbnail_url": None,
                "subscriber_count": None,
                "view_count": None,
                "video_count": None,
                "stats_fetched_at": None,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            channels.append(ch)
        return ch

    items = []
    for idx, yvid in enumerate(slice_ids, start=1):
        vrow = next((r for r in videos if r.get("youtube_video_id") == yvid), None)
        if not vrow:
            ch = _ensure_channel(yvid)
            vrow = {
                "id": _new_id("vid"),
                "youtube_video_id": yvid,
                "channel_id": ch["id"],
                "title": f"Trending {yvid}",
                "description": None,
                "published_at": None,
                "duration_seconds": None,
                "default_language": None,
                "region_code": regionCode,
                "category_id": None,
                "thumbnail_url": None,
                "view_count": None,
                "like_count": None,
                "comment_count": None,
                "stats_fetched_at": None,
                "trending_rank": None,
                "trending_fetched_at": None,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            videos.append(vrow)

        vrow["region_code"] = regionCode
        vrow["trending_rank"] = offset + idx  # global rank within feed
        vrow["trending_fetched_at"] = now
        if category_row:
            vrow["category_id"] = category_row["id"]
        vrow["updated_at"] = now

        # constraints
        if vrow.get("trending_rank") is not None and (not isinstance(vrow["trending_rank"], int) or vrow["trending_rank"] < 1):
            _set_status(req, "failed", "CONFLICT", "Stored video constraint violated: trending_rank must be >= 1.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Stored video constraint violated: trending_rank must be >= 1.")

        items.append(vrow)

    _save("channels.json", channels)
    _save("videos.json", videos)

    next_offset = offset + len(items)
    next_token = None
    if next_offset < len(feed_ids):
        next_token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(str(next_offset).encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8").rstrip("=")

    req["cache_hit"] = False
    _set_status(req, "succeeded", response_summary={"returned": len(items), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    return {
        "regionCode": regionCode,
        "categoryId": categoryId,
        "items": items,
        "pageToken": next_token,
        "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": False},
        "request": {"id": req["id"], "youtube_quota_cost": req["youtube_quota_cost"], "status": req["status"]},
    }

tool_schemas.name: get-video-categories
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of available YouTube video categories for `regionCode`, optionally served from or persisted to cache based on `cacheMode`. The response includes category IDs and localized titles for the requested region. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid region codes, NOT_FOUND when categories are unavailable for the region (or are missing in CACHE_ONLY), FORBIDDEN when category data is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

regionCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to fetch available video categories for.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior for this tool call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_video_categories(regionCode, cacheMode=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0304000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0304000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _stable_fingerprint(tool_name, params):
        def _canon(v):
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                return {k: _canon(v[k]) for k in sorted(v.keys())}
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [_canon(x) for x in v]
            return v
        blob = json.dumps({"tool_name": tool_name, "params": _canon(params)}, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{random.randint(1000,9999)}"

    def _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cache_mode, quota_cost):
        ts = _now()
        return {
            "id": _new_id("req"),
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "status": "queued",
            "request_params": params,
            "request_fingerprint": _stable_fingerprint(tool_name, params),
            "cache_mode": cache_mode,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "response_summary": None,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "youtube_quota_cost": int(quota_cost),
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }

    def _set_status(req_row, status, error_code=None, error_message=None, response_summary=None):
        ts = _now()
        allowed = {
            "queued": ["running", "cancelled"],
            "running": ["succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"],
            "succeeded": [],
            "failed": [],
            "cancelled": [],
        }
        cur = req_row.get("status")
        if status != cur:
            if cur not in allowed or status not in allowed[cur]:
                return False
        req_row["status"] = status
        req_row["updated_at"] = ts
        if status == "running" and not req_row.get("started_at"):
            req_row["started_at"] = ts
        if status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
            if not req_row.get("started_at"):
                req_row["started_at"] = ts
            req_row["finished_at"] = ts
        req_row["error_code"] = error_code
        req_row["error_message"] = error_message
        req_row["response_summary"] = response_summary
        return True

    start = time.time()
    tool_name = "get-video-categories"
    params = {"regionCode": regionCode}
    if cacheMode is not None:
        params["cacheMode"] = cacheMode

    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
    categories = _load("video_categories.json")

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(regionCode, str) or len(regionCode) != 2 or not regionCode.isalpha() or regionCode.upper() != regionCode:
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode or "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "regionCode must be a 2-letter uppercase ISO country code (e.g., US).", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "regionCode must be a 2-letter uppercase ISO country code (e.g., US).")
    if cacheMode is None:
        cacheMode = "read_through"
    if cacheMode not in ("bypass", "read_through", "cache_only"):
        req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, "read_through", 0)
        _set_status(req, "running")
        _set_status(req, "failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR", "cacheMode must be one of: bypass, read_through, cache_only.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        api_requests.append(req)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cacheMode must be one of: bypass, read_through, cache_only.")

    # Request row
    req = _make_request_row(tool_name, params, cacheMode, 0)
    api_requests.append(req)
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
    if not _set_status(req, "running"):
        _set_status(req, "failed", "INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal api_requests status transition.")
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Illegal api_requests status transition.")

    # cache_only: return cached categories or NOT_FOUND
    if cacheMode == "cache_only":
        rows = [c for c in categories if c.get("region_code") == regionCode]
        if not rows:
            _set_status(req, "failed", "NOT_FOUND", "No categories available in cache for region (cache_only).", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No categories available in cache for region (cache_only).")
        req["cache_hit"] = True
        _set_status(req, "succeeded", response_summary={"returned": len(rows), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("youtube_category_id") or ""))
        return {
            "regionCode": regionCode,
            "items": rows,
            "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": True},
            "request": {"id": req["id"], "youtube_quota_cost": req["youtube_quota_cost"], "status": req["status"]},
        }

    # bypass/read_through: upsert deterministic set of categories
    quota_cost = 1
    req["youtube_quota_cost"] = quota_cost
    now = _now()

    # deterministic set; include common YouTube category ids
    base = [
        ("1", "Film & Animation"),
        ("2", "Autos & Vehicles"),
        ("10", "Music"),
        ("15", "Pets & Animals"),
        ("17", "Sports"),
        ("19", "Travel & Events"),
        ("20", "Gaming"),
        ("22", "People & Blogs"),
        ("23", "Comedy"),
        ("24", "Entertainment"),
        ("25", "News & Politics"),
        ("26", "Howto & Style"),
        ("27", "Education"),
        ("28", "Science & Technology"),
    ]
    # region variation: shuffle titles slightly but stable
    seed = int(hashlib.sha256(("cat:"+regionCode).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    base2 = base[:]
    rng.shuffle(base2)

    upserted = 0
    for yc_id, title in base2:
        # unique(region_code, youtube_category_id)
        existing = None
        for c in categories:
            if c.get("region_code") == regionCode and c.get("youtube_category_id") == yc_id:
                existing = c
                break
        if not existing:
            existing = {
                "id": _new_id("cat"),
                "region_code": regionCode,
                "youtube_category_id": yc_id,
                "title": title,
                "assignable": True,
                "fetched_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            categories.append(existing)
            upserted += 1
        else:
            existing["title"] = title
            if not isinstance(existing.get("assignable"), bool):
                existing["assignable"] = True
            existing["fetched_at"] = now
            existing["updated_at"] = now
            upserted += 1

    _save("video_categories.json", categories)

    rows = [c for c in categories if c.get("region_code") == regionCode]
    if not rows:
        _set_status(req, "failed", "NOT_FOUND", "No categories available for region.", {"latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No categories available for region.")

    req["cache_hit"] = False
    _set_status(req, "succeeded", response_summary={"returned": len(rows), "upserted": upserted, "latency_ms": int((time.time()-start)*1000)})
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("youtube_category_id") or ""))
    return {
        "regionCode": regionCode,
        "items": rows,
        "cache": {"mode": cacheMode, "hit": False},
        "request": {"id": req["id"], "youtube_quota_cost": req["youtube_quota_cost"], "status": req["status"]},
    }

tool_schemas.name: analyze-channel-videos
tool_schemas.description: Fetches recent videos for `channelId` (bounded by `maxResults` and optional publish window) and returns an aggregated analysis of performance trends derived from the retrieved video metadata/statistics, using `regionCode` for contextualization where applicable. Underlying reads are paged internally as needed up to `maxResults`, and results may be reused from or written to cache depending on `cacheMode`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ranges or malformed timestamps (including `publishedAfter` > `publishedBefore`), NOT_FOUND when the channel does not exist or required data is missing in CACHE_ONLY, FORBIDDEN when the channel/videos are not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

channelId.description: The YouTube channel ID to analyze (e.g., UC...).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of recent videos to include in the analysis.

publishedAfter.description: Only include videos published at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

publishedBefore.description: Only include videos published at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

regionCode.description: Two-letter region code to contextualize metadata (e.g., US).

cacheMode.description: Caching behavior for underlying YouTube reads and stored results.

tool_schemas.name: enhanced-transcript
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves transcripts for one or more `videoIds` and returns rich transcript artifacts including optional caption-level entries, optional full concatenated text, optional text search matches (`query`), and optional time-window filtering (`startMs`/`endMs`), and can additionally return an equal-time segmented transcript when `segmentCount` is provided. The response contains per-video results; when multiple videos are requested, failures are reported per video rather than aborting the entire request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ID list size, inconsistent time windows (e.g., `endMs` < `startMs`), negative/over-limit segmentation, or unsupported flag combinations, NOT_FOUND when a video/transcript is unavailable or not present in CACHE_ONLY, FORBIDDEN when captions cannot be accessed, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

videoIds.description: List of YouTube video IDs to fetch transcripts for in one request.

startMs.description: Start of time filter window in milliseconds from video start.

endMs.description: End of time filter window in milliseconds from video start.

query.description: Search query to match within transcript text.

includeFullText.description: Whether to include a full concatenated transcript in addition to caption-level entries.

includeCaptions.description: Whether to include caption/line-level transcript entries with timestamps.

segmentCount.description: If provided, also return a segmented transcript split into this many equal time segments.

cacheMode.description: Caching behavior for transcript reads and derived transcript artifacts.

tool_schemas.name: get-key-moments
tool_schemas.description: Extracts up to `maxMoments` timestamped key moments from the video’s transcript for `videoId`, optionally preferring the requested `language`, and returns a structured list of moments (no pagination). Respects `cacheMode`: `read_through` will fetch and cache the transcript and derived moments if missing, `cache_only` returns only previously cached/derived results, and `bypass` recomputes without reading/writing cache. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for missing/invalid parameters (including `maxMoments` outside 1–50), `NOT_FOUND` if the video or an eligible transcript is unavailable (or if `cache_only` has no cached transcript/moments), `FORBIDDEN` if access to the video/transcript is not permitted, and `RATE_LIMITED` when request quotas are exceeded.

videoId.description: The YouTube video ID to extract key moments from.

maxMoments.description: Maximum number of key moments to return.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code used for moment extraction (e.g., en).

cacheMode.description: Caching behavior for transcript retrieval and key-moment derivation.

tool_schemas.name: get-segmented-transcript
tool_schemas.description: Splits the video’s transcript for `videoId` into `segmentCount` equal-duration time segments and returns the transcript text with timestamps per segment, optionally preferring the requested `language`, as a single non-paginated result. Respects `cacheMode`: `read_through` will fetch and cache the transcript and derived segmentation if missing, `cache_only` returns only previously cached/derived results, and `bypass` recomputes without reading/writing cache. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for missing/invalid parameters (including `segmentCount` outside 1–200), `NOT_FOUND` if the video or an eligible transcript is unavailable (or if `cache_only` has no cached transcript/segmentation), `FORBIDDEN` if access to the video/transcript is not permitted, and `RATE_LIMITED` when request quotas are exceeded.

videoId.description: The YouTube video ID to segment the transcript for.

segmentCount.description: Number of equal time segments to split the video into.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code for the segmented transcript (e.g., en).

cacheMode.description: Caching behavior for transcript retrieval and segmented transcript derivation.

tool_schemas.name: list-api-requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool calls (api_requests) with optional filtering by tool name, status, fingerprint, and created/finished time windows. Returns a paginated list ordered by most recent first; refuses invalid filters or out-of-range pagination.

cacheHit.description: Filter by whether the request was served from cache.

createdAfter.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp.

createdBefore.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp.

finishedAfter.description: Only include requests finished at or after this timestamp.

finishedBefore.description: Only include requests finished before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-api-request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single api_requests record by id, including request/response metadata and any recorded error details. Refuses when the id is invalid or not found.

id.description: Primary key of the api_requests row.

tool_schemas.name: cancel-api-request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight api_requests row by id by transitioning status to cancelled. Only allowed when the request is currently queued or running; refuses if the request is already terminal or the id is not found.

id.description: Primary key of the api_requests row to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for auditability.

tool_schemas.name: list-video-text-assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached/derived text assets for videos (video_text_assets), including transcripts, transcript segments, key moments, and comment assets. Supports filtering by video, asset type, status, language, and derivation, and returns a paginated list ordered by newest first; refuses invalid filters or out-of-range pagination.

language.description: Filter by asset language (BCP-47 when applicable).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-video-text-asset
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single video_text_assets record by id, including its status, text fields, and payload. Refuses when the id is invalid or not found.

id.description: Primary key of the video_text_assets row.
